links.outcome: Exam question accuracy of LLMs with versus without knowledge-graph RAG grounding
links.effect: Integrating CMedRAGBot (graph RAG) significantly improved test accuracy of all five LLMs, with increases of up to approximately 10%.
links.quote: The results indicate that the integration of CMedRAGBot significantly improves the test accuracy of all models, with increases of up to approximately 10%.

unlisted_practices: Medical knowledge graph construction with NER (Chinese-RoBERTa+BiGRU) for entity linking in RAG
Data augmentation to improve NER generalization (F1 95.27% to 97.55%)
Prompt-based intent recognition module mapping user queries to predefined intent categories

screen.practice: retrieval grounding with knowledge graph added to existing LLMs
screen.reason: The study tests the addition of a Graph RAG pipeline (CMedRAGBot) across five existing LLMs on medical examination benchmarks, directly evaluating the impact of retrieval grounding on QA accuracy.
